title: rat arithmetic and conversions
purpose: Observe the values produced by the operation.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.3: rat arithmetic is exact; unary minus preserves rat; .int() truncates toward zero; .float() is explicit. language owner decision, 21.10.2026 (D-046): different numeric categories interact only after an explicit cast; no implicit promotion, so int/byte operands are converted with .rat().
